categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Newtouch Software Co., Ltd. primarily operates in IT solutions, software development outsourcing, IT product sales and value-added services, and innovative flow business. The company focuses on providing software development, system integration, and cloud computing services mainly to financial institutions such as banks and insurance companies, as well as other industries including telecommunications, automotive, and government sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies in big data, artificial intelligence (AI), cloud computing, and mobile internet. Key platforms include the Newtouch AI platform, Newtouch One development platform, and Newtouch X cloud resource management platform. It employs agile development and DevOps methodologies, microservices architecture, and has developed specialized industry data models and AI knowledge bases, particularly for the financial sector.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Newtouch serves primarily financial institutions including major banks and insurance companies such as China Pacific Insurance, China Life Insurance, and China Construction Bank. It also serves telecommunications, automotive, government, retail, and overseas markets. The company maintains long-term strategic relationships with large clients in these sectors, focusing on digital transformation and AI-enabled solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters in Shanghai Free Trade Zone. It has subsidiaries and investments in multiple Chinese cities including Beijing, Chongqing, Chengdu, Wuhan, and overseas operations in Japan. The overseas business accounts for a smaller portion of revenue but includes subsidiaries in Japan and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Newtouch operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the software and IT services supply chain. It develops and delivers software solutions and IT services directly to end customers, mainly enterprises and financial institutions, rather than producing hardware or raw materials.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on embracing artificial intelligence, especially generative AI (AIGC), and integrating AI deeply into its core business. It invests heavily in R&D for AI platforms, cloud computing, big data, blockchain, and open-source software. New product development emphasizes AI-enabled intelligent solutions, PaaS platforms, and industry-specific digital transformation tools, with a strong focus on financial services and enterprise digitalization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of software development services, IT solutions, and IT product sales. The company uses a direct sales model involving bidding, competitive negotiation, and business negotiation. It also earns income from subscription-based SaaS services, innovative flow business platforms, and value-added cloud services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Newtouch is positioned as a leading domestic software service provider in China, especially strong in financial IT solutions for insurance and banking sectors. It competes with other software and IT service firms in China’s rapidly growing digital economy, leveraging its proprietary technologies and long-term client relationships to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Newtouch achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.68 billion, a 27.92% increase year-over-year, and returned to profitability with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 68.6 million. The company’s total assets reached RMB 2.7 billion, growing 13.42% from the previous year. R&D investment accounted for over 10% of revenue, reflecting a growth-oriented and innovation-driven profile.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Newtouch emphasizes its deep industry expertise, especially in financial services, and its advanced proprietary technologies such as AI platforms and big data models tailored for insurance and banking. Its integrated AI and cloud platforms enable rapid deployment and intelligent automation, providing clients with customized, scalable, and secure digital transformation solutions. The company’s strong project management and quality assurance systems further differentiate its offerings.
